# Tour on Your Time: Introducing Self-Guided Home Tours


Tri Pointe Homes Washington


•


September 2, 2026


Share this article


Life doesn’t always fit neatly within standard business hours, and your new home search shouldn’t either. Between work, relationships, and everything else on your calendar, finding time to tour homes can feel challenging. And sometimes, you simply want the freedom to explore at your own pace, take a closer look at the details, and quietly imagine what life could feel like in each space.


At[Tri Pointe Homes© Washington](https://www.tripointehomes.com/find-your-home/wa/greater-seattle-area) , we understand that every homeowner’s journey is different. That’s why we’re now offering self-guided home tours powered by UTour at select communities, giving you greater flexibility to explore when it works for you.


From picturing weeknight dinners in the kitchen to deciding which room could become your home office, a self-guided tour gives you the time and space to experience the home on your terms. No rushing, just an opportunity to look around, ask yourself what feels right, and envision the moments you could create there.


## How to Schedule a Self-Guided Tour


Getting started is easy:


1.


**Find a home you'd like to explore:** Visit our website and select "Schedule a Self-Tour" on an eligible home.


2.


**Register and choose your time:** Select an available appointment that fits your schedule.


3.


**Check your email:** Before your tour, you'll receive a one-time access code to unlock the front door.


4.


**Arrive a home:** Visit during your scheduled time and use your access code to enter.


5.


**Explore at your own pace:** Walk through each room, notice the thoughtful design details, and imagine how the home could complement your lifestyle.


## Your Home Search, Made More Convenient


Buying a home is an exciting milestone, but we know it can also feel emotional and overwhelming. Self-guided tours offer a convenient, comfortable way to take the next step on your schedule and at your own pace.


If you have questions before or after your visit, our New Home Specialists are ready to provide answers, share additional details, and help guide you through the next stage of your homebuying journey.


**Ready to tour? Explore self-guided tours at Arborstone**[here](https://tripointe.utourhomes.com/visitor?community=111fafaf-02dd-4001-ac2a-92d896df3707&rootUrl=community&lang=en) **or at Timberstone**[here](https://tripointe.utourhomes.com/visitor?community=7a8196c7-3e63-46ee-8d8a-9af72ad8e15e&rootUrl=community&lang=en) **.**
